headline: Tresor condemns Helsing AI military event at Kraftwerk
caption:
Tresor speaks out against a Helsing AI military event at Kraftwerk Berlin.

The Berlin institution issued a statement condemning the event. In its words, such an event "has no place in the spaces our community has built".

Should club communities have a say in who else uses their venues? 👇

article.headline: Tresor condemns Helsing AI military event at Kraftwerk
article.standfirst: Tresor has issued a statement condemning a military event held by Helsing AI at Kraftwerk Berlin.
body: Tresor has issued a statement condemning a military event held by Helsing AI at Kraftwerk Berlin.
The Berlin institution said such an event "has no place in the spaces our community has built".
The statement puts the club at odds with the use of a Berlin space closely linked to its community for an event tied to AI and the military.
